why: THE GROUP HUG BECOMES THE WIN CONDITION. The deck already forces every opponent to draw 3-6 a turn out of a 99-card library and then bills them 2 or 3 for it; this branch stops billing and takes the library instead. Out: the three hand-size punishers, Tireless Tribe, Wall of Glare, Darien, plus the counters/token cards that do not serve the plan (The Ozolith, Hangarback Walker, United Front). In: Otherworld Atlas (colourless, scales every turn), Mind's Eye (a card off EVERY opponent draw), Folio of Fancies (no maximum hand size, an {X}{X} group draw, and a mill-for-hand-size kill), and five X-spell finishers - Blue Sun's Zenith (reusable, point it at a library), Fascination (draw X or mill X, same card), Drown in Dreams (both modes with a commander out), Even the Score (costs {U}{U}{U} less if an opponent drew four or more this turn, which Font of Mythos makes automatic) and Universal Surveillance (improvise - the eight rocks pay for it). Plus Krang the All-Powerful to double every draw trigger. NEITHER INSTRUMENT CAN GRADE THE UPSIDE. All nine adds return NOTHING or draw={unmodelled} from goldfish.classify, and Otherworld Atlas, Fascination and Folio of Fancies each carry Forge's AI:RemoveDeck:All, so the sim would hold the three keystones and never cast them. That is why the pre-registered objective grades the DOWNSIDE instead: the real risk of a list this full of X spells is unkeepable hands, and keep_t3 is a figure the model does see. This branch is a paper playtest, not a simulation result, and must not be merged on a sim number.
